state_updated.description: whether STATE.md was edited this time

worth_digesting.description: whether this time's content is worth putting into the cross-project digest; false when it only confirms things work and nothing substantive changed

summary.description: a summary for the cross-project digest, at most three sentences, in the content language named in the prompt (when worth_digesting is false, it may briefly say why nothing was updated, or be empty)

reason.description: why this judgement was made (updating STATE.md or not), for a person spot-checking later; in the content language named in the prompt
